headline: TMT-multiplexed MS/MS quantifies histone H3 PTMs in single cells and clinical proteomes
label: Computational Peptide Spectrum Inference
summary: Multiplexed TMT profiling now spans longitudinal CSF cohorts, plasma biomarker panels, and triggered MS/MS of single-cell histone modifications.
synthesis: The dominant thread is multiplexed quantitative mass spectrometry paired with computational spectrum-level interpretation to resolve protein and modification abundance in biological samples. The histone H3 study uses TMT-multiplexed triggered MS/MS with super heavy TMT triggers to quantify PTMs in single cells, a case where targeted acquisition and quantification are tightly coupled. The childhood ALL study generates a TMT-based CSF dataset of 356 longitudinal samples from 178 patients at diagnosis and consolidation, quantifying more than 3,000 proteins. The intervertebral disc study instead derives a six-protein plasma panel for grading and predicting degeneration; its summary does not specify a spectrum-level workflow, so it contributes clinically oriented biomarker stratification rather than inference methodology. What is new is the pairing of multiplexed quantitative workflows with large longitudinal clinical cohorts.
